name: Metlen Energy & Metals PLC
summary: Metlen Energy & Metals PLC operates as a global industrial and energy enterprise with a primary focus on the metals and energy sectors. Its extensive energy operations include the full lifecycle of thermal power facilities, from development and construction to ongoing operation, as well as the design and implementation of essential electricity infrastructure projects. The company is also deeply invested in developing renewable energy sources (RES) and energy storage solutions, overseeing the management of various power generation and energy plants, and providing retail electricity and natural gas supply. Furthermore, Metlen sources and manages natural gas and other energy products for major B2B corporate clients and leads large-scale projects aimed at electricity production and facilitating the energy transition. In its metals division, the firm handles the extraction, processing, and refining of materials like alumina, aluminum, bauxite, and various other metals and minerals. Beyond these core areas, Metlen specializes in a diverse range of infrastructure construction, encompassing road networks, buildings, railway and port developments, and solid and liquid waste management systems. It also designs, constructs, operates, and maintains a broad spectrum of infrastructure, building, environmental, hydraulic, and energy-related projects. Established in 1908, Metlen Energy & Metals PLC is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
